param.name: tools_to_run
param.displayname: Tools to run, 8 total (comma-separated, e.g., '1,2,3' or 'all' for complete pipeline)
param.dialogReference:
Tool 1: Aggregate Media - Sum concentration values by unique cell ID

Tool 2: Simple Join (OPTIMIZED) - Join point grid with aggregated CSV data (KEEPS ALL POINTS)

Tool 3: Clip to Boundary - Clip to boundary & reproject (optional)

Tool 4: Set Null to Zero - Replace NULL concentration values with 0

Tool 5: IDW Interpolation - Interpolate points to smooth raster surface

Tool 6: Scale rasters by 1 billion

Tool 7: Convert to integer data type

Tool 8: Add M1 and M2 rasters

param.name: Year_dir
param.displayname: Chemical Attribute Data year folders directory location

param.name: year_input
param.displayname: Year to process (optional - leave blank for all years)

param.name: point_grid
param.displayname: Empty Point Grid (with UniqueID field matching CSV uID values)

param.name: cleanup_previous
param.displayname: Clean up previous run before starting

param.name: run_name
param.displayname: Run name (optional - for organizing multiple runs)

param.name: clip_boundary
param.displayname: Clip Boundary (optional - defines output coordinate system if provided)

param.name: cell_size
param.displayname: Output Cell Size for Rasters (in output coordinate system units)

param.name: reference_raster
param.displayname: Reference Raster for Cell Size (optional - overrides cell size parameter)

param.name: input_directory
param.displayname: Input directory for continuing pipeline (optional - specify existing step output)

param.name: idw_power
param.displayname: IDW Power Parameter (default=2, standard inverse distance weighting)

param.name: idw_num_points
param.displayname: IDW Search Radius - Number of Points (default=4)
